Implemented on branch `task/qwen2-sglang-draft-topk1` at commit `25df666`.

Diagnosis: `unified.draft_topk1` used the eager Torch path: repeated `argmax`, probability/position bookkeeping, and a `torch.cat` chain for speculative steps. In case 0, simulated R0 was 21.8261554837 us versus R5/R6 at 0.15207 us, or 143.53x over the hardware limit (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`).

Fix: changed `DRAFT_TOPK1_BACKEND` from `"torch"` to `"triton"` in [qwen2_dense_sglang_before.rs](simulator/src/arch/qwen2_dense_sglang_before.rs:11), using the existing fused partial-argmax/finalize implementation. Shapes, request-count input, model-work labels, and CostTree topology are unchanged. The paired test still verifies the 14-leaf structure and non-draft configuration.

Rows are Analyzer case citations `pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`, `pred.casev1.optimality-kernel-ladder`, `pred.casev2.optimality-kernel-ladder`, and `pred.casev3.optimality-kernel-ladder`. The case-0 aggregate R5/R6/R7 floors also remain unchanged: 36.3631807039 us, 35.8049656174 us, and 29.5449659872 us respectively (`pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown`). The after CostTree still contains 14 leaves, with only the draft backend now `triton` (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`).
